title: Controlled Corrective Implementation Authorization
controller_contract: Widen only the v0.33 utility selector input layer from 7 to 10.
Add a label-free posterior-context helper using softmax(reference_logits,dim=1)[:,1], softmax(candidate_logits,dim=1)[:,1], and their signed difference.
Detach all three posterior-context tensors before selector concatenation.
Add/retain explicit shape, floating-type and finite-value validation.
Construct exactly [B,10] selector features from the frozen seven features plus the frozen three posterior features.
Preserve selector hidden width 16, scalar logit output, sigmoid semantics, utility target construction and intervention mapping.
alignment_contract: Introduce an M4qusli-only Stage-A preparation path that computes aligned modalities, evidence estimates, interaction representation and deterministic stable-reference/candidate counterfactual fused embeddings before learned selector finalization.
Introduce an M4qusli-only Stage-B finalization path accepting the three detached posterior features, computing the learned selector intervention and producing final fused_embedding.
Prevent silent use of the legacy one-stage M4qusli selector path after implementation.
runner_contract: For M4qusli only, invoke Stage A before final classification.
Reuse the existing classification model to classify stable-reference and candidate counterfactual embeddings.
Derive the frozen detached label-free posterior context from those logits.
Classify the finalized fused embedding through the existing classification model.
Reuse the same reference/candidate logits for the existing label-indexed training-time u_target.
Do not introduce a second classifier, target leakage, new loss family, new utility-loss weight, new threshold, new seed or training schedule.
regression_contract: Python compile passes for all five allowlisted files.
Posterior helper returns exact class-1 softmax probabilities and signed difference.
Posterior helper requires no labels and returns detached tensors.
Selector-loss gradient does not flow through posterior features into reference/candidate logits.
Two-stage model path returns stable-reference, candidate and final fused embeddings with expected batch/shared dimensions.
Existing utility target remains label-indexed supervision only.
Existing BCEWithLogits utility objective remains unchanged.
Non-M4qusli architectures remain on their existing path.
Focused selector and observability regression suites pass.
execution_fail_closed: Abort before staging if any exact source anchor required for deterministic implementation is absent or ambiguous.
Abort and restore tracked implementation files to this Step6 authorization commit if compile or focused tests fail.
Do not commit a partially passing implementation.
Stage only the exact five allowlisted source/test files plus the subsequent implementation evidence record.
